name: TH Placement Billing Register
query:
select
	si.name as sales_invoice,
	si.customer as customer,
	si.th_placement_case as placement_case,
	si.posting_date as posting_date,
	si.due_date as due_date,
	si.grand_total as grand_total,
	si.outstanding_amount as outstanding_amount,
	si.docstatus as docstatus
from `tabSales Invoice` si
where si.th_placement_case is not null
	and si.th_placement_case != ''
order by si.posting_date, si.name
